 PROFILE: Who is the defense’s expert witness Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente?
 Allison Co ,
 ABS-CBN News
 Published November 19, 2026 12:38 PM PHT 
  | 
 Updated November 19, 2026 01:59 PM PHT 
 Defense witness Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente. Screengrab from Senate of the Philippines/Youtube MANILA — Following the ASEAN Summit, the Senate impeachment court convened on Thursday as the defense presented its seventh witness — expert witness Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente. Dela Fuente is a certified public accountant, lawyer and anti-money laundering compliance practitioner.
 Counsel for the respondent Mark Vinluan said Dela Fuente’s knowledge and experience “will enlighten the Court of fundamental legal concepts related to the Anti-Money Laundering Law” to prove that the allegation of unexplained wealth against Vice President Sara Duterte is “erroneous, malicious, and without merit.”
 Formerly part of the Anti-Money Laundering Council, Dela Fuente said he entered in 2015 as a financial investigator whose proper designation was Bank Officer II. Part of his duties were handling compliance matters and producing reports to help law enforcement agencies in investigating predicate crimes.
 In 2021, Dela Fuente opened his law firm which he said helps clients craft their own money laundering and terrorist financing prevention programs, as well as institutional risk assessments, among other services.
 ADVERTISEMENT
 Akbayan Party-List Rep. Chel Diokno, House prosecutor, questioned the defense’s line of questioning on the witness who is delivering credentials on anti-money laundering.
 Presiding Officer Francis "Chiz" Escudero however stated that Dela Fuente's qualification as an expert witness allows him to give his opinion, as opposed to ordinary witnesses, who may not.
